reason: Retain the initial generator and specification because the verified source-only feedback shows moment differences compatible with the analytic Monte Carlo scale, without an indicated extraction, conversion, or model-moment defect. Avoid tuning parameters to one random source realization.
addressed_findings: Reviewed all 12 source replay statistics linked to the frozen initial generator/specification; no missing rows.
Calculated conditional Monte Carlo scales for means and sample SDs; retained the model rather than claiming an improvement from sampling noise.
Recognized shared source seed and matched row ordering produce perfectly scaled source A/B moment deviations, so checks are not independent replications.
Preserved original z evidence, explicit y-unit derivations, all source strata, and fixed protocol seeds.
remaining_limitations: Lognormal family/tails, interpolation, row independence, and source-to-target transport remain assumptions.
Source sample sizes, precision, and rounding uncertainty are unavailable.
Source consistency is not target or clinical validation; no independent target outcome was available or inspected.
Monte Carlo scale assessment is conditional on the retained model and is not a preregistered pass/fail test.
